swaps.min_out_reason: min_out is a swap instruction argument, not emitted in the event.
swaps.quote_age_reason: would require joining the swap to the QuoteStaged oracle_publish_time; not yet implemented.

freshness.source: live RPC reads at export time

history.quote_attribution_note: QuoteStaged/QuoteCommitted events carry version + nonce but not the keeper; keeper attribution is only observable from the live QuoteState account, not retroactively from events.

limitations: Coverage is bounded by what the configured RPC provider retains; earlier history is a gap, not zero activity.
No historical Pyth/SOL observations are indexed: markouts and quote-age are PENDING.
min_out is an instruction argument, not an event field: shown as N/A.
Quote attribution (keeper) is not reconstructable from events; only the live QuoteState keeper is shown.
Fee buckets are liabilities, not LP profit; inventory changes are not PnL.
Block times are absent on very old transactions; those rows carry null block_time.

lp.nav_per_share_reason: NAV requires a reserve valuation; shown only when a live oracle price is available.
lp.protocol_fee_buckets_reason: Fee buckets accrue inside the Vault account and are not emitted as events; read from the Vault snapshot, but they are a liability, not LP profit.

markouts.reason: No historical Pyth/SOL price observations are indexed, so post-trade markouts cannot be computed. Current prices are never substituted for historical ones.
